title: MomsKitchen
tagline: Decentralizing restaurants by making the world's moms-kitchens a decentralized restaurant.
description:
Great food comes from all the "moms kitchens" around the globe.
But most moms lack the capital and business savvy to launch and run a restaurant. Since most moms have a functional kitchen all they need is way to launch and run a mini restaurant.
In comes Web3 providing a low to no-cost server, database, platform, currency and captive clientele capable of uplifting "moms kitchens" out of poverty faster than any governmental agency. And that is an impactful social good.
If moms-kitchen can sell 50 to 100 $20 meals per day that is $1000 to $2000 in revenue daily.
Thus, with a little help from Web3 moms-kitchen becomes profitable.
And most of all because it is Web3-based "moms kitchen" accepts crypto creating widespread crypto adoption.
how_its_made: This project  was built using React and Smart contracts. While we intended using Sponsor systems like SKALE for low gas costs, Lens or OpenSea as a base frontend, Alluo as a Wallet, Push or XMTP  for messaging and IPFS & Filecoin for NFTs we ran out of time. With a larger team more could have been accomplished
